svg.title: The Monthly Nut on a Revenue Vehicle
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-04-revenue-vehicle-monthly-cost; chapter number: 2; chart type: horizontal_bars; title: The Monthly Nut on a Revenue Vehicle; subtitle: Black SUV all-in costs versus the components and a WAV minivan route; caption: Stack the full monthly cost before signing: a 100 percent financed Navigator runs $3,000 to $3,300 all in, a 2025 Escalade at a 620 credit score lands near $3,500, and a used Sienna WAV runs about $1,300 while still qualifying for XL.; assumptions note: Where a speaker gave a single figure, min, max, and typical are set equal. Navigator typical uses the almost-$3,000 figure cited when renting out the former Tesla. Escalade figures reflect one caller's credit profile.; note: ESCAPE THE MATRIX (fPh6slkW9Tk @ 00:05:15, fPh6slkW9Tk @ 00:06:08, fPh6slkW9Tk @ 00:09:45, Y8ppyxLqw9E @ 00:02:13) and Yusuf Benallal (xrJ-xGav6Xo @ 00:03:19).; unit: USD per month; bars: label: 2025 Escalade at a 620 credit score; min: 2993.81; max: 3500; typical: 3500; display: $2,993.81 note, about $3,500 with insurance; label: Lincoln Navigator all-in, NYC Black; min: 3000; max: 3300; typical: 3000; display: $3,000 to $3,300; label: Navigator car note at 0% APR; min: 1733; max: 1733; typical: 1733; display: $1,733; label: Used Toyota Sienna WAV all-in; min: 1300; max: 1300; typical: 1300; display: About $1,300; label: Navigator commercial liability; min: 370; max: 370; typical: 370; display: $370
